803-3510-3875-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-3510-3875-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

2092-5231-8167.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 7 or greater.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1879-3259-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
1879-3259-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3033-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
3033-6495-6972.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

339-677-3899-7060.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

728-1365-4853-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
728-1365-4853-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4050-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1981-2415-4050-6458.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Repeat.

2869-3184-6798--173.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature that costs {0}.
Yomiji triggers, returning that creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2757-4365-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two creature tokens due to Mondrak.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic land
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

670-1619-4142-6140.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6140.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Cloister Gargoyle until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Cloister Gargoyle to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Cloister Gargoyle enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Cloister Gargoyle trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Cloister Gargoyle until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

236-1636-5371-7629.description:
Animate Hourglass of the Lost using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life.
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
236-1636-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

513-5636-6896.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland permanent card in hand that costs {2} or less.
You control a nontoken nonland permanent that costs {2} or less.
513-5636-6896.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a nonland permanent card that costs {2} or less.
Cast the permanent from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {0} due to Green Goblin.
Hullbreaker Horror trigger, returning another nonland permaennt that costs 2 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 2.
Repeat.

1494-4153-7152.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
You control a creature that has five or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1494-4153-7152.description:
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving five +1/+1 counters from a creature to Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-4153-7152.notes: If you cast a noncreature spell before combat, you can put four +1/+1 counters on The Thing. This means if it had a +1/+1 counter to start, it can serve as the creature with five or more +1/+1 counters on it.

1479-2841-3678-6155.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-3678-6155.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Retreat to Emeria and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

586-1472-2292-5626.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-1472-2292-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

1170-1328-2105-6965.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1328-2105-6965.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

1414-2866-4659-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

277-1409-3470-6839.description:
Activate Ignis by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ignis enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ignis.
Resolve the Ignis trigger, causing you to look at the top six cards of your library and put a land card from among them onto the battlefield.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Lotus Cobra and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land that entered
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
277-1409-3470-6839.notes: This combo can fail if Ignis does not reveal a land. You can use additional mana to restart the combo if desired should this happen. The combo also assumes every land you grab will be mana-producing.

413-1336-2178-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 5 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
413-1336-2178-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it and Heronblade Elite trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, putting its counters on Heronblade Elite.
Resolve the Heronblade Elite trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

4210-4593-4659-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Pious Evangel triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Thopter and Phyrexian Mite die, Wayward Disciple triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
4210-4593-4659-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

1651-2073-2099-6757--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the noncreature artifact enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the noncreature artifact returned in step 1 and the Munitions token, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the noncreature artifact.
Repeat.
1651-2073-2099-6757--90.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions to get infinite damage if desired. If the noncreature artifact chosen can sacrifice itself without tapping or additional costs, you can omit the sacrifice outlet, but will forego the possibility of infinite damage.

2558-5226-6351--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-5226-6351--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Teval triggers. Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1461-4050-4078-5870.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1461-4050-4078-5870.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life and get {E}{E}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1477-5776-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1477-5776-5777.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

186-457-1247.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
186-457-1247.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Pili-Pala, adding {U}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

3129-3933-4929-5479.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3129-3933-4929-5479.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

969-3259-3349.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
969-3259-3349.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Glissa triggers, creating two Incubator artifact tokens with two +1/+1 counters on them.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature you control, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the beginning of your next combat phase, Glissa triggers, transforming all Incubators you control into 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creatures.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

643-3670-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
643-3670-4508.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ingenious Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Ingenious Artillerist is a Pirate due to Maskwood Nexus, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Ingenious Artillerist triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1000-2743-4840.manaNeeded: {7}{U}, plus an additional {1} if Mystic Reflection was not foretold
1000-2743-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Biovisionary.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four Biovisionary tokens.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

1171-1409-3499.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

1765-2232-2557-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have an Aura card in hand with mana value one or less.
You control an Aura with mana value one or less.
You have enough mana available to cast the Aura in hand.
1765-2232-2557-4050.description:
Cast an Aura with mana value one or less by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control.
The Aura enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Chishiro.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return any other Aura with mana value one or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chishiro trigger, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

721-1111-2724.notablePrerequisites: Temporal Adept does not have summoning sickness.
721-1111-2724.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Temporal Adept by paying {U}{U}{U} and tapping it, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4215-5209-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Worldspire Wurm.
Worldspire Wurm dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the Worldspire Wurm trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Worldspire Wurm, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Worldspire Wurm's power.
Repeat.
